column1: # The shared boundary tests (tests/boundary.py), in-process, in this language: the bridge has only the shared map to pass values (the host puts the value under "in" and reads "out"), so up and down are map calls. @V@ is the value written here, @ID@ the case; a case with no line is one this bridge cannot express.

column2: LET v = AETHER_MAP_GET('in')@NL@LET put = AETHER_MAP_PUT('out', v)
